style_profile.title: CineForge Low-Fidelity Previz
style_profile.summary: A production-readable schematic animation language for camera, blocking, motion, and prop/location staging review.
style_profile.identity_strategy: Keep characters distinct through silhouette, wardrobe color blocking, and minimal on-costume labels only when identity would otherwise be ambiguous.
style_profile.location_strategy: Render locations and props only to the level needed for staging, entrances, exits, and scene geography.
style_profile.motion_priority: Prioritize camera path, subject blocking, and movement arcs over surface detail.
detail_suppression: ambient decoration not needed for staging
prompt_guidance: Use simplified, flat-shaded schematic animation rather than polished final imagery.
Keep silhouettes clean and backgrounds restrained.
Preserve continuity anchors such as key props and their positions.
Treat audio as secondary to readable camera and blocking.

prompt_text:
Create a low-fidelity previs clip in CineForge's shared house style.
This is previs, not a final render. Make camera placement, blocking, motion, subject positions, prop positions, and location readability obvious at a glance.
House style: A production-readable schematic animation language for camera, blocking, motion, and prop/location staging review.
Visual treatment: simplified flat-shaded animation, clear silhouettes, restrained texture, non-photoreal finish.
Characters to keep distinct: Subject A, Subject B.
Identity handling: keep characters distinguishable through silhouette and wardrobe color coding; add minimal chest labels only if identity would otherwise be unclear.
Shot brief: A lateral tracking move follows two officers along a blue corridor while a radio command orders them to hold position.
Tone cue: urgent.
Color cue: navy, teal.
Track laterally so movement across the set stays easy to read.
Keep movement measured and intentional.
Continuity anchor: The amber flashlight stays with the lead officer.
Audio cue: A dry radio dispatch over light room tone.
Dialogue cue: Unit three, hold position until the lights settle.
Suppress distracting detail: no photoreal surfaces, no elaborate set dressing, no beauty pass, no cinematic prestige finish.
Keep the same simplified house style that would read consistently across other previz clips.
Engine guidance: Use concise physical language with explicit camera, lighting, motion, and blocking instructions. Avoid abstract theory unless it directly affects the frame.
notes: Prompt-only identity/style consistency requested; no reference images assumed.
